en.body: A lakehouse case that provisions AWS storage with Terraform, lands simulated event data in S3, and processes silver and gold Delta layers in Databricks with PySpark.
en.cta: Read the full story on the site and use GitHub as the operational proof point.

pt.body: Um caso de lakehouse que provisiona storage AWS com Terraform, pousa eventos simulados em S3 e processa camadas silver e gold em Databricks com PySpark.
pt.cta: Leia a historia completa no site e use o GitHub como prova operacional.
